# api-documentation
> OpenAPI 3.0 generator from code-defined routes: define(method, path, {...}) with a tiny schema notation, emit valid openapi.json plus a markdown reference. Zero dependencies.

An OpenAPI 3.0 generator driven from code-defined routes, not YAML. Call `define(method, path, {...})` with a tiny schema notation, get back a structurally valid `openapi.json` plus a markdown reference page.

## API
- `ApiDocumentation`
- `extractPathParams`
- `toOpenApiSchema`
- `toMarkdown`

## Install
Each library is a standalone GitHub repo under github.com/Ruzylo-cloud.

Part of the Ferrow open-source toolkit: https://github.com/Ruzylo-cloud/ferrow-toolkit — sponsored by https://ferrow.ai
